task.title: Starting Diesel Engine at Warm (Mechanical engine)
task.shortdesc: Turn the ignition key to the ON position and then to START position, without waiting

step.cmd: Turn the ignition key to the ON position and then to START position, without waiting for the preheat light to go OFF. At the same time fully depress the accelerator.
Release the ignition key when the engine starts and release the accelerator pedal to a low idle position. Release the ignition key after engine starting and check the engine conditions.
